name: Eau Claire River (Harstad–Fall Creek)

gaugeContext.note: No representative discharge gauge has been reviewed for these trips. Black River and Chippewa River gauges mentioned in older guides are not substituted for Eau Claire River flow.

timing.note: Access information and published approximate mileage are available. No reviewed local speed/flow model or transferable guide time is assigned.

blurb: Two forested Eau Claire River paddles between Harstad County Park and the County K bridge near Fall Creek. Harstad–County D has reported Class I rapids; County D–K includes Little Falls. These trips end upstream of Big Falls and are distinct from the urban Altoona stretch and the Eau Claire River near Wausau.

sections.takeOut: Eau Claire River County D Landing
sections.notes: A forested paddle from Harstad County Park to the County D bridge, with sandy bends and reported Class I rapids. Low water can make parts shallow, and fallen trees can change the route. Inspect the steep County D take-out and arrange a vehicle shuttle before launching.
sections.routeReview: The access areas are mapped. A candidate river line crosses old bends and wooded bank margins, so the dotted path remains under review. No landing-to-channel connection or passage through current obstructions is verified.

distanceEvidence.note: The September 2013 firsthand trip report gives 8.5 miles for Harstad–County D. Its archived mapped line measures about 8.50 miles. Treat this dated guide distance as approximate; channel changes and landing choice can change the actual trip. A shorter USGS candidate is held because some bends do not align well with imagery.

putInAccess.operator: Eau Claire County Parks & Forest Dept. (ownership 'County' in the WDNR record)
putInAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
putInAccess.note: DNR record 3722 remains a county carry-in site, not marked abandoned. The current county park-feature layer independently identifies canoe landing 20 about six metres away, and the county park map identifies the same approach. Trees obscure the exact shoreline in imagery; preserve the original Area coordinate and no river-bank claim. These records confirm the facility, not present-day open status or obstacle clearance.
putInAccess.directions: Enter Harstad County Park and follow the signed canoe-landing approach toward the river. The county park map shows the landing beside the short parking approach. Expect a carry to the water; check current park access and fees before launching. This Area marker retains the DNR facility coordinate, not a confirmed shoreline point.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Eau Claire County Outdoor Recreation Plan 2022–2027 — Table 17, public boat landings
takeOutAccess.note: The county plan identifies this bridge landing and its southeast approach. Its approximate coordinate is preserved from the linked firsthand trip map, corroborated by a separate dated trip report and satellite imagery. No field inspection, exact shoreline coordinate, parking entitlement beyond signed public access, or verified river bank is claimed.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the public access on the southeast side of the County Road D bridge over the Eau Claire River. The approach is steep; inspect the carry and footing before unloading. The Area marker shows the documented approach, not an exact water-edge landing; follow current signs.

sections.takeOut: Eau Claire River County K Landing
sections.difficulty: Reported Class II–II+ at Little Falls
sections.notes: A shorter forested paddle to the County K beach access. Little Falls is just before the take-out; assess it from shore and confirm a suitable passage or carry before committing. End at County K: Big Falls is farther downstream and is not part of this trip. Arrange a vehicle shuttle and inspect both carries.
sections.routeReview: The dotted line shows the general river course, with generalized banks and sandbars. It does not map a safe passage through Little Falls, the bridge, current obstructions or exact shoreline connections.

notices.title: Little Falls before the take-out
notices.text: Dated firsthand reports describe Class II to II+ rapids at Little Falls just upstream of County K. Check present conditions and scout before committing. Take out at County K; the more difficult Big Falls downstream is outside this trip.
notices.sourceName: Miles Paddled — Harstad to County K, May 2016; Wisconsin River Trips, June 2020
